Channels in Go

In Go, channels are a typed conduit through which you can send and receive values with the channel operator, <-. Unbuffered channels synchronize sender and receiver.

Declaring Channels

ch := make(chan int)
go func() {
    ch <- 42
}()
val := <-ch

Closing a channel signals to receivers that no more values will be sent:

close(ch)
for v := range ch {
    fmt.Println(v)
}

Select

The select statement multiplexes over multiple channel operations, blocking until one can proceed.

  • A channel send on a full buffered channel blocks.
  • A receive from an empty channel blocks.
  • default makes a select non-blocking.
